Special Screenings

A number of special screenings or events take place at the Riverview. Please be aware that there may be a different admission price or policy in effect for these screenings. Our regular film programming schedule runs from Friday-Thursday. Because of an occasional special event, our schedule can change from day to day, so it is best to check the schedule for the particular day you plan to attend.

Watsky - x Infinity 2026 Tour

To celebrate the 10th anniversary of his album x Infinity, Watsky is taking it on the road in a format that combines a live concert with a screening of the album's visual film. Watsky will perform the album in its entirely alongside a synced projection of the album film. Monday, October 19th at 7:00pm. Click here for more info, tickets are on sale now!

Buy Tickets

Canoe Dig It?

Canoe Dig It? is a mockumentary comedy that follows a group of disparate competitors as they travel up to a national Freestyle Canoeing competition in Maine. The film is very much akin to Chrisopher Guest's Best in Show. One showing on Monday, September 28!

Buy Tickets

They're Here

Join us for an early screening of "They're Here," a short horror documentary about the ICE occupation of Minneapolis. This 25-minute film will be followed by a Q&A with filmmakers Laura Poitras, Rachel Lauren Mueller and Adam Mellion in conversation with local leaders involved in the resistance against ICE. Wednesday, October 7th at 5:45pm.

Who's the We?

"Who's the We?" is a documentary about a team of bike riders who pedaled 3,265 miles from San Diego, California to St. Augustine, Florida, along the U.S.–Mexico border. Monday, September 28th at 5:00pm. Free Admission. More information can be found at whosthewe.org.

Buy Tickets

Minnesota Neighbors

Minnesota Neighbors premiere. From the Not In Our Town Filmmaking Team comes a documentary about the ICE surge in Minnesota. Thursday, October 15th at 7:00pm. Tickets are on sale now.
